criticalBugFixed.bug: Module-level shared dedup cache in use-social-realtime.ts
criticalBugFixed.symptom: When both NotificationBell and SocialScreen mounted the hook, the first instance to process an event added its eventId to the shared cache, causing the second instance to skip it — SOCIAL_ACTIVITY_CREATED events were silently dropped by SocialScreen when NotificationBell processed them first
criticalBugFixed.fix: Moved dedup cache from module-level Set to per-instance useMemo (createDedupCache() factory). Each hook instance gets its own bounded LRU cache.
criticalBugFixed.verification: Phase 7 browser test: B's feed now shows new activity WITHOUT reload after the fix
